notes.title: Bugfix Release
notes.content:
A new bugfix release is out. This fixes several stability issues on Windows and MacOS:

[list]
[*] [b]Windows[/b]: Fix issue with Windows exceptions causing the game to crash, usually in relation to certain antivirus programs like Avast.
[*] [b]MacOS[/b]: Fix sound playback issues for devices with samplerates higher than 44.1kHz
[*] [b]MacOS[/b]: Improve sound playback performance
[*] [b]MacOS[/b]: Fix scaling issues arising from HiDPI displays
[/list]

Thank you for your patience and for playing Eternia!
